tspan.tspan: Cryptic co-infection prevalence in field/greenhouse-collected plant RNA-seq

Upstream: meta_search.py + meta_text.py full-text pipeline → meta_classify.py (6,467 full-text-gated BioSamples). Co-infection: field 473/2,719 (17.4%) greenhouse 54/980 (5.5%) controlled 77/914 (8.4%)
